summary: Six footswitches and eight LEDs in a printed case, on an Arduino Uno. Each switch sends a MIDI note, and the LEDs light for the notes they are sent. The notes travel as serial over USB, and a bridge on the computer turns them into MIDI, so its socket carries data rather than class-compliant MIDI.

jacks.name: usb
jacks.label: USB
jacks.note: The Uno's USB-B: power in, and serial MIDI both ways, through a Hairless bridge on the computer.
